title: Code and data for: Shipyard transporter capacity choice for single or coupled carriage of heavy hull blocks at equal service
description: Scheduling, fleet-sizing and pricing code, the result tables behind every number, table and figure of the article, and the transporter price sources (Supplementary Tables S1 and S2). The digitised road network of the main shipyard, the instances generated on it and the individual schedules are not included, because travel times reveal the facility layout; they are available to reviewers on request. The second case uses the published data of Liu et al. (2022) and can be rerun end to end. See README.md.
